Page 78
Oct. 5th Mr. Edmund Abbott - 77 - Tampa, Florida - sight failing .... Francis Hart - 43 - Operation for supposed cancer stomach - Enrolled To-day perpetually
James Balasco and his Father Augustus
Adelle Galvin - 32 - Thanksgiving asked ... . lost mind last January was given up by Drs. as hopeless ..... Was prayed for and Enrolled and now home taking care of her little twins. Deo Gr.
2nd Catherine Joyce - 45 - had lump in breast, was worrying sick, was en- rolled last Saturday a week and told to keep her hands away from the lump & now almost gone.
Vincent Law - 17 - disobedient
Andrew Young - 17 - operation two months ago - tuomer on sholder. Now Drs. want to remove whole arm. - is enrolled To-day promising more fre- quent Communion, etc if ....
Page 79 Oct. 5 Frank Linder - 72 - Cancer like in throat can not eat - hardly take a swallow of liquid - Enrolled To-day perpetualy. Dr's give no hope of recovery
Lawrence Pomaville - 5 - had diptheria with little brother who died. Boy can now walk though for some weeks was carried in to services Wednesday. . . Thanks ...
Oct. 5th Baby Thomas O'Sullivan - 2'2 - Enemic - Lukemia, no "red blood Enrolled To-day
6 Marie Maly - 16 - Spinal maningitis - beautiful, happy girl - "life of family ... ... "Hopeless" Enrolled $5 Dec. 22 Here to-night quite happy almost O.K. Deo Gr.
